purpose: Per-book CO2 estimates across model tiers + serving modes. Computed by scripts/co2-per-book-comparison.py in the sourcelibrary repo.

book_token_budget.source: Average across books with index/summary generated in tracking window (2026-01-02 to 2026-05-23). Computed as total Gemini tokens / books with summary or index generated in window.
book_token_budget.denominator_note: Per-book numbers in this file use a 13,145-book denominator captured 2026-05-24. As of 2026-05-26 the same query returns 14,295 (the window kept accumulating new books). Per-book CO₂ figures derived from this file are ~8% high relative to the current denominator; will be re-derived on next pipeline data refresh.

uncertainty_notes: Bottom-up (BU) values are theoretical floors. They assume optimal batching, peak utilization, and apply MLPerf + stack overhead correction factors. Cross-checked against MLPerf v5.1 within ~36%.
LCA-scaled values are theoretical ceilings. They scale Mistral Large 2's published 2.85 mg CO2/token (full cradle-to-grave LCA) by active param ratio.

Truth is somewhere between. Production overhead beyond MLPerf benchmark conditions adds 2-5× to bottom-up; training/embodied amortization in actual deployment is less than Mistral's single-model LCA implies.
All Pro and Opus numbers depend on undisclosed active parameter counts. ±50% on params translates to ±50% on per-token energy.
